author: Nia Warfield
title: Tuesday, 21
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Tim Seymour was a buyer of Canopy Growth
Brian Kelly was a buyer of SPDR Gold Shares
Steve Grasso was a buyer of Lennar
Guy Adami was a buyer of HollyFrontier Corp
